title: Log Field Ontology Registry and Runtime Mapper for Cross-Service Structured Logs
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Problem: Services produce heterogeneous structured logs (different field names, nesting and typing) which makes cross-service queries, dashboards and alerting brittle. Current ad-hoc mappings in dashboards and per-service ingest pipelines add maintenance overhead and cause missed traces when correlation fields are named differently.

Goal: Ship a centrally-managed Log Field Ontology Registry (LFOR) and a lightweight runtime mapper in the ingest path that: 1) canonicalizes commonly-used log fields (request_id, user_id, trace_id, route, http_status, latency_ms, error_code) across services; 2) emits mapping hints and canonical field metadata for downstream indexers (Loki/ES) and dashboards; 3) provides a versioned registry UI and API so product/platform teams can propose and review field mappings; and 4) supports non-breaking fallthrough so services can opt-in incrementally.

Scope: Implement the registry service (CRUD + versioning + audit), integrate a mapper module into the ingress adaptor (sidecar/edge relay path) that applies per-service mapping rules at ingest time, add enrichment annotations to Loki log lines (x-lfor-version, x-field-source), and update a set of canonical dashboard queries/alerts. This ticket covers design, implementation of the registry API and the runtime mapper component, tests, a canary rollout plan, and docs/owner onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: 1) LFOR service accepts field mapping definitions and maintains version history; 2) Runtime mapper applies mappings for at least three onboarding services and adds x-lfor-version header in logs; 3) Kibana/Loki dashboards can query canonical fields across services and return consistent results; 4) No >1% increase in median ingestion latency at canary; 5) Rollout runbook and rollback steps documented.
notes:
Design decisions: Use a typed ontology (string/int/float/timestamp/boolean) + optional normalization hooks (trim, lowercase, iso8601 parse) to reduce downstream parsing. Trade-offs: adding runtime mapping increases ingestion CPU; we will implement a lightweight rule engine and offload heavy transforms to a batch reprocessor if needed. Registry will store mappings in Postgres with optimistic concurrency. Security: registry changes are audited and gated by ACLs; runtime mapper runs within the existing ingest service boundary (no new egress).

Rollout plan: 1) deploy LFOR in staging; 2) ship mapper feature flag gated per-team; 3) canary with low-traffic service (auth) for 48h; 4) expand to 3 more services; 5) open owner sign-up for additional services.

Artifacts: Design doc (Confluence) https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Log+Field+Ontology+Registry; UI mockups (Drive) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF; RFC PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/512; initial implementation PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/589
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: short design review with PM and Observability squad. Agreed to keep initial ontology intentionally small (10-15 canonical fields). Next: finish schema for normalization rules.
2026-03-05 - Spike complete: evaluated two rule engines (jq-based vs tiny embedded JS). Selected tiny sandboxed JS for flexibility (lower risk than full jq embedding).

2026-03-08 - Eng review: Will add x-field-source and x-lfor-version metadata to all transformed log output. PM asked for a user-friendly UI to propose mappings—tracked separately but registry API will expose proposal endpoints.

2026-03-10 - First PR opened (runtime mapper skeleton): https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/589. CI failing on one unit test for timestamp normalization; investigating timezone parsing edge-case.

2026-03-11 - Ops note: Verified metrics to capture mapper CPU and per-log processing time. Added Prometheus counters: lfor_mapper_processed_total, lfor_mapper_errors_total, lfor_mapper_p95_latency_ms.
2026-03-12 - PM feedback: Add a migration plan for existing dashboards and include sample Kibana queries in the docs. Assigned follow-up to PM for outreach to platform teams.
